name: 33020 · Hollywood, FL
findings: ZIP 33020 (Hollywood) has 172 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33020 (Hollywood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33020 (Hollywood) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
